merchant/31666.htm.text: Spellbook Seller Lumen: Welcome to Aden, the city of culture and prosperity! I'm Lumen. I sell the best spellbooks in the city! I also deal in countless magic ingredients, and my selection rivals the Ivory Tower! If you're looking for anything in particular, let me know!

links.text: "Who is the lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"
